# Lab 16.4: Lock Down a Cloud Storage Bucket

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a bucket with every important protection turned on, and prove that it cannot be made public.

## Steps

1. **Create a hardened bucket.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked \
  --location=us-central1 \
  --uniform-bucket-level-access \
  --public-access-prevention \
  --enable-versioning \
  --soft-delete-duration=7d</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Check the settings.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets describe gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked \
  --format="yaml(uniform_bucket_level_access,public_access_prevention,versioning_enabled,soft_delete_policy)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Try to make it public.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked \
  --member=allUsers --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It fails because public access prevention is enforced.

4. **Grant least privilege.** Give a group read access to objects only, not bucket admin.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked \
  --member=group:gcp-developers@YOUR_DOMAIN --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Turn on Data Access logs for Cloud Storage.** In **IAM & Admin → Audit Logs**, find **Google Cloud Storage** and tick **Data Read** and **Data Write**. Now every read is logged.

6. **Share one object for a short time.** Use a signed URL instead of making anything public. You need a service account you can impersonate:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">echo "report" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked/report.txt
gcloud storage sign-url gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked/report.txt --duration=10m \
  --impersonate-service-account=SIGNER_SA@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-locked</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Public access | Impossible on this bucket |
| Access model | IAM only, no ACLs |
| Recovery | Versioning and 7-day soft delete |
| Temporary sharing | Signed URL that expires |
